label: Investigative Research
description: Plan and execute investigative research: identify sources, build document trails, cross-reference data, identify leads, and structure the investigation methodology.

modelTier.notes: Sonnet for research planning. Opus for complex cross-border investigations requiring deep synthesis.

guidedInputs.label: Investigation Subject
guidedInputs.description: What are you investigating? Describe the suspected story, allegation, or public interest issue.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Suspected misuse of public procurement funds by a regional government contractor. Initial tip: contract awarded without competitive tender.

guidedInputs.label: Evidence / Leads So Far
guidedInputs.description: What documents, sources, data, or tips do you already have?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. One whistleblower source (unverified). Public contract registry shows 4 contracts to same company 2019-2023. Company registered same month as first contract.

guidedInputs.label: Investigation Type
guidedInputs.description: What type of investigation is this?

guidedInputs.label: Resources & Constraints
guidedInputs.description: Time available, team size, geographic scope, access constraints, legal risks.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 2 journalists, 3 months, EU-based, limited budget for travel. Subject has previously threatened legal action against press.
